notes:
CIRCUIT: a single-node-pair (parallel) network. A -2A current source on the far left feeds a 10-ohm series resistor into a top rail (y~365) that runs the width of the sheet; hanging off that rail to the bottom rail (y~590) are a 5-ohm resistor (x~334), a 10 mF capacitor (x~476), a 5 V source (x~677); the rail then passes through a 20-ohm resistor (x~894) into the right-hand column (x~975) which contains a 3 H inductor down to the bottom rail. The bottom rail is grounded by the GND symbol at (543,630).

NET MAP (4 nets):
  0  = ground / bottom rail (y~583-605, full width): I-DC bottom 6.1, R5 bottom 2.1, capacitor bottom 5.0, V-DC bottom 4.1, inductor bottom 3.1, GND 7.0.
  n1 = the top rail between the 10-ohm resistor and the 20-ohm resistor: R10 right end 1.1, R5 top 2.0, capacitor top 5.1, V-DC top 4.0, R20 left end 0.0.
  n2 = short right-hand segment between the 20-ohm resistor's right end (0.1) and the top of the 3 H inductor (3.0), via the corner at (967,364).
  n3 = the left-hand column: top terminal of the -2A source (6.0) up to the left end of the 10-ohm resistor (1.0).

CRITICAL SITE DECISIONS (all five are plain T's - one wire ends on another - no crossings anywhere on this sheet, so no ambiguity arose):
  S7 (671,365) JUNCTION - top rail with the 5 V source's top lead running down. Clean T, stub terminates on the rail. Crossing is not even expressible (deg 3); reading it as 'none' would strand the V-DC top terminal on a one-terminal net.
  S9 (334,371) JUNCTION - top rail with the 5-ohm resistor's top lead. Clean T. Other reading would leave R5 top floating.
  S16 (477,591) JUNCTION - bottom rail with the capacitor's bottom lead. Clean T. Other reading would strand the capacitor bottom.
  S17 (557,588) JUNCTION - bottom rail with the stem of the GND symbol. Clean T. Other reading would leave the circuit with no ground reference at all.
  S18 (332,596) JUNCTION - bottom rail with the 5-ohm resistor's bottom lead. Clean T. Other reading would strand R5 bottom.
Non-critical sites also confirmed as junctions: S6 (967,364) corner where R20's right lead turns down into the inductor column; S10 (477,371) T of the capacitor column onto the top rail; S15 (679,583) T of the V-DC bottom lead onto the bottom rail. S0/S1/S2 (~877,326 etc) and S5 (246,339) are the handwritten '20 Ohm' and '10 Ohm' labels brushing the resistor boxes; S11 (721,511) is the '5V' label; S12/S13 (~508,516) are the '10mF' label touching the capacitor's bottom lead. All label ink, no terminals on them, left at default.

PORT FIXES:
  #4 V-DC: the tracer had t1 on p2@(720,502), which is a stroke of the handwritten '5V' label to the right of the source, giving the one-terminal net n4. The real bottom lead is p1@(678,533), which runs down to the bottom rail at S15. t1 -> p1.
  #5 Capacitor: the tracer had t1 on p2@(526,503), a stroke of the handwritten '10mF' label, giving the one-terminal net n5. The real top plate lead is p1@(475,445), which runs up to the top rail at S10. t1 -> p1 (t0 left on p0@(474,510), the bottom lead). Capacitor terminal order is unscored.
Both one-terminal-net warnings are resolved by these two fixes; no bridges dropped, no merges, no class changes. Every drawn symbol matches its label (3 resistors, 1 inductor, 1 capacitor, 1 V-DC with a +/- circle, 1 I-DC with an arrow circle, 1 GND).
